source.label: Community-supplied Tekken 1 move list
source.note: Button notation converted to 1/2/3/4. Historical inputs are preserved; flagged entries need verification.

portraits.credit: Original game artwork: Namco. Portrait sheet extracted by Unstabledproton; archived by The Spriters Resource.
portraits.note: The original game uses the same select portrait for Yoshimitsu and Kunimitsu.

characters.name: Anna Williams

throws.name: Chin Bash
throws.notes: Continue into either Leg Scissors Arm Snap or Sidestep Arm Snap.

moves.name: Flipkick
moves.notes: Start crouching. Use ub, u or uf.

moves.name: Lightning Flipkick
moves.notes: Start crouching. Use ub, u or uf. Tap the upward direction.

combos.name: Mid punch/Punt kick
combos.notes: Tap down for the punch; release down before 4.

chains.name: Sidestep Arm Snap
chains.notes: During Chin Bash. Can continue into Falling Arm Snap or Double Arm Snap.

notes: Moves and routes adapted from the supplied historical list. Timing and hit conditions matter; unverified entries are marked individually.

characters.name: Heihachi Mishima

moves.name: Sweep, Roundhouse
moves.notes: Time the second 3 after the first sweep finishes, before Heihachi rises.

combos.name: Double Power Uppercut
combos.input: f, d, df+2 > f, d, df+2

combos.name: Power Uppercut/Double Axe Kick
combos.notes: The combo listing uses f, d, f+4, 4, while the standalone Double Axe Kick entry uses a crouching input. This mismatch is preserved for verification.

combos.name: Power Uppercut/Power Punch
combos.input: f, d, df+2 > d, df, f+2
combos.notes: Enter the Power Punch immediately after the launcher.

combos.name: Power Uppercut / Hammer / Power Punch
combos.notes: Wait until the opponent falls to just above shoulder height, then tap d for the hammer. The source typo "D,D F" is normalized to d, df.

combos.name: Super Uppercut/Hammer/Power Punch
combos.notes: Wait until the opponent falls to just above shoulder height, then tap d for the hammer.

unblockables.name: Windup Punch
unblockables.notes: Keep rotating counterclockwise until the count reaches five, then tap 1. The supplied list describes the full charge as unblockable and a one-hit finish; earlier releases can be blocked.

characters.name: Kunimitsu

moves.name: Tornado Spin
moves.notes: Repeat up to five times. The fifth spin causes dizziness.

moves.name: Tornado Sweep
moves.notes: Repeat up to five times; the fifth causes dizziness. Spins and sweeps can be mixed by rolling between b and db.

combos.input: f, d, df+2 > f, d, df+2
combos.notes: This route appears in the supplied Kunimitsu section but duplicates a Mishima route without a matching launcher in her move list. Kept for reference; verify before using.
